summary: rec.gov + FS current. $18 (rec.gov; FS page says $20), 2nd vehicle $10, 8 people. 31 sites (25 reservable, 6 FCFS), max 58 ft, no hookups, water + vault toilets, dump 15 mi. Season 2027 06-04..09-19. Creekside stands: east-loop sites 028/029/025/023 ~17-30 m from a ~10-m creek. PIN ~630 m off -> 44.1636,-107.2525. Phone empty -> (307) 431-7446.
flags: WATERFRONT 'creekside' STANDS (checked hard): West Tensleep Creek is ~10-12 m wide at the campground (so creekside, not riverfront). East-loop sites 028 (44.16341,-107.25181) ~17 m, 029 (44.16410,-107.25170) ~20 m, 025 (44.16318,-107.25186) ~23 m, 023 (44.16301,-107.25190) ~29 m from the channel edge on imagery, with a one-tree-deep fringe of conifers on the bank (028 and 025 are open pads); all four are reservable nightly on rec.gov. rec.gov: 'sits on the banks of West Tensleep Creek'. Borderline only in that a few bank trees stand between - not continuous canopy.
